title: Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace
abstract: arXiv:2609.35473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. translated_title: 手写文本识别存在于高方差像素子空间中
translated_abstract: 在用于手写文本识别（HTR）的自监督预训练中，像素重建方法优于对比方法，这与自然图像分类中的情况不同。我们认为这种差异源于判别性信号在像素空间中的位置：对于HTR而言，判别性信号集中在高方差方向上，而在低方差方向上基本不存在。这预示着保留高方差像素内容的目标函数将具有最佳的迁移效果。我们在六个跨越五种语言的手写基准数据集上，在匹配的编码器、数据和评估协议下，测试了来自三个家族（基于像素的MIM、JEPA和对比学习）的六种SSL方法。在完整标签条件下，基于像素的SSL在每个基准测试和两种冻结探测评估中都取得了最低的字符错误率（CER），能够暴露逐位置的字符信息，而其他家族的方法只能通过读出层恢复这些信息，并且它是唯一能从真实手写体预训练中受益的家族。
tldr: 该论文揭示了手写文本识别的判别性信息集中在像素空间的高方差方向上，从而解释了为什么基于像素重建的自监督预训练方法优于对比学习方法，并在五种语言的六个手写基准上均取得最低字符错误率。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the discriminative signal for handwritten text recognition lies in high-variance pixel directions, explaining why pixel-reconstruction self-supervised pretraining outperforms contrastive methods and achieves the lowest CER across six handwriting benchmarks in five languages.
